item.text:
The campaign ran for the full June 27–July 9 BST flight and is now paused.

- **Spend:** $394.67 of the $400 budget
- **Impressions:** 368,604
- **Link clicks:** 197
- **Installs:** 20 reported through “Wallet installed”

The fifth post, which makes the July 9 deadline clear, recorded the most link clicks and one reported install. The posts stating the receipt-sorting offer more directly also contributed installs. The campaign used the verified install pixel for conversion tracking; X only allowed impression billing for this website conversion setup.
